findings.issue: Duplicate 'Why Choose Healthy Oats?' sections on homepage
findings.description: Two consecutive sections with identical titles exist. The first uses simple benefit cards (Leaf, Clock, Heart, CheckCircle icons). The second uses gradient-enhanced cards (Award, Heart, Clock, Sparkles icons). The user requested replacing the old section, not adding a new one alongside it.
findings.action: Remove one of these sections — likely the second one (lines 246-304) based on the implementation plan showing the first was the intended replacement.
